create_RoPE_module: create a RoPE module with given feature dimension, max sequence length, and base frequency
apply_RoPE_forward: apply RoPE embedding to an activation tensor with optional sequence offset
build_RoPE_with_offset: build a RoPE module and apply it to a tensor starting from a non-zero sequence offset
test_RoPE_forward: test the RoPE forward pass on a tensor to verify rotated output shape matches input
review_RoPE_class: review the RoPE class implementation of rotary position embeddings for transformer models
